definition.question: How intense is international legal and diplomatic pressure on Israel?
definition.low_end: Israel retains broad diplomatic support with no active binding international legal findings, arrest warrants or coordinated sanctions.
definition.high_end: Binding ICJ rulings, enforced ICC arrest warrants and coordinated UN and state sanctions and recognition measures impose comprehensive diplomatic and economic isolation on Israel.
